subject: MAP follow-up: Integration build commitments (SDK / Streaming / Tool-calls)
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthsync.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: integrations@healthsync.io
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + MAP draft (call earlier today)

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. I wanted to capture the key milestones we talked through and make sure Redwood and HealthSync are aligned on owners and the target close date. Draft notes below — please correct anything I've missed.

High-level goal: deliver SDK integration + streaming tool-calls so HealthSync can route clinical notes into our summarization pipeline by mid-October (target prod launch 2026-10-18).

Proposed MAP milestones (from our call):
- M1: SDK integration (basic send/receive) — due 2026-09-10 — Owner: HealthSync (Alex) / Redwood POC: Grace
- M2: Streaming + KV cache validation for 4k windows — due 2026-09-24 — Owner: Redwood (Marissa) / HealthSync infra (Priya)
- M3: Tool-calls (structured lab lookup) integration and sample schema — due 2026-10-01 — Owner: HealthSync (Alex) / Redwood (Karthik)
- M4: Structured outputs & regression checks on clinical prompts — due 2026-10-10 — Owner: Redwood Eng (Marissa) / HealthSync QA (integrations@healthsync.io)
- M5: Pilot cutover & rollback plan — target 2026-10-18 — Joint owners

Dependencies we discussed:
- HealthSync to provide test dataset + auth creds (S3 + temporary service account) — needed by 2026-08-31
- Security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) requested by procurement — Redwood to return by 2026-08-28
- DocuSign for starter SOW (procurement) — target signature 2026-09-07

Attachments: I'll upload a short MAP_Draft_HealthSync_v1.pdf and a preliminary sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx to the shared Drive.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Grace: confirm Redwood owners and whether the streaming milestone can be broken into two smaller checkpoints (latency validation + kv-cache correctness).
2) Alex / Priya: confirm who on your infra team will hand us test creds and whether the dataset is shareable outside the VPC (or do we need a sanitized sample).
3) Marissa / Karthik: flag any blockers or additional infra work needed on Redwood side.

Happy to hop on a 30-min alignment call later this week if helpful.

— Alex
Senior PM, Integrations
HealthSync
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthsync.io>, integrations@healthsync.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + MAP draft (call earlier today)

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. I made inline confirmations and a couple of small edits below. Attaching our MAP_Draft_HealthSync_v1.pdf (high level) and the checklist for SDK steps.

Quick confirmations / clarifications:
- M1 (SDK basic): Redwood can ship an example client by 2026-09-03 and provide a validation harness. HealthSync to validate with your test dataset.
- M2 (Streaming): Marissa suggests we split this into M2a: streaming latency baseline (2026-09-17) and M2b: KV cache correctness & scaling test (2026-09-24). I'll update the MAP doc.
- Security questionnaire: we're on it — Grace will own returning the Red team answers by EOD 2026-08-28.
- Tool-calls structured schema: Karthik will draft a minimal OpenAPI + example responses and share by 2026-09-20.

Open asks for HealthSync:
- Can you confirm the expected average sequence length and worst-case clinical note size? We need that to size batching and kv-cache policies.
- Are tool-calls required for 100% of flows or only for specific workflows?

Proposed next touchpoints:
- HealthSync infra sync (15m): Tue 2026-08-25 10:00am PT — Priya?
- Roadmap review with procurement: Thu 2026-08-26 11:00am PT

If that looks good I'll circulate an updated MAP with split milestones and owners.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya@caregrid.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + MAP draft (call earlier today)

Grace / Alex — Priya here from HealthSync infra (copying my address from integrations). Quick answers:
- We can provide a sanitized test payload set (S3 presigned links) by 2026-08-30. I'll assign our infra engineer, Liam Park, to coordinate creds.
- Average note length: ~600 tokens; worst case we've seen ~3.2k tokens. Tool-calls: used by ~35% of flows initially, we'll aim to expand after pilot.

I'll be on the Tue 8/25 10am PT sync. If Redwood needs to run inside our VPC for any component during validation, let me know — we can discuss a short-term peering or VPN.

— Priya
Integrations Lead (HealthSync)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@caregrid.com>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthsync.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + MAP draft (call earlier today)

Thanks Priya — that token distribution helps. Quick tech notes / Redwood commitments: 
- We'll produce a Node + Python sample client that implements streaming with incremental commits to the KV cache. Expect the repos by 2026-09-03.
- For 3.2k worst-case inputs we'll recommend 4k window quant profile; Karthik and I will produce a tuning doc and a suggested quant/replica config by 2026-09-10.
- On tool-calls: Karthik will own the OpenAPI contract and a small router example that calls external lab lookup. We'll stub calls in the sample client so HealthSync can test flows without full backend access.

Blockers we see today:
1) SOC2 evidence — Grace is returning the questionnaire by 8/28; procurement needs that for SOW to move.
2) DocuSign SOW — please confirm mannequin SOW value so our legal can draft (Alex: are you able to confirm ballpark committed spend so we can align on contract terms?).

I'll post the SDK checklist (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx) to the shared Drive and ping when it's live.

— Marissa
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthsync.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: integrations@healthsync.io
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + MAP draft (call earlier today)

All — quick update from our side after internal procurement check:
- Procurement needs the SOC2 evidence (Grace) and the SOW draft to reach an internal approval meeting on 2026-09-08. If Redwood can return both items the week of 8/31, we should be on track for the signature target of 2026-09-07 (they may accelerate if we move fast).
- On spend: tentative pilot commitment of $25k over 3 months (covers reserved capacity for pilot + high-touch support). That should be sufficient for Legal to draft a starter SOW.

I appreciate the split on streaming milestones — please go ahead and update the MAP. Let's keep the shared Drive updated with the checklists and the sample client repos.

Next immediate asks:
- Grace: SOC2 questionnaire returned by 2026-08-31 EOD (procurement put slight pressure on turnaround).
- Marissa / Karthik: sample client repo links + SDK checklist posted by 2026-09-03.

If those land, I'll route to procurement for the 9/8 review. Thanks team — will be available for the 8/31 9am PT stand if helpful.

— Alex
Senior PM, Integrations
HealthSync
